links.comparator_used: Non-RAG baseline (same LLM, DeepSeek-R1-0528, without retrieval)
links.outcome: Expert-graded response performance on cervical cancer management and gynecologic oncology surgery question sets
links.effect: RAG systems generally outperformed the non-RAG baseline; largest gains on complex surgical questions, modest and heterogeneous improvements on guideline-based cervical cancer management questions. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Across domains, RAG systems generally outperformed the non-RAG baseline.
